children: Hong Kong property developer's interim revenue dropped 89% yr/yr due to fewer unit deliveries
Company swung to profit, aided by one-off gain from loan waiver by non-controlling shareholder
No interim dividend declared for the period
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current quarter or full year in press release
FEWER UNIT DELIVERIES - Co said revenue fell mainly due to fewer deliveries of completed residential units
ONE-OFF LOAN WAIVER - Profit boosted by a one-off, non-cash gain from waiver of HK$285.8 mln loan and interest by non-controlling shareholder
IMPROVED GROSS MARGIN - Gross profit margin rose due to lower costs associated with properties delivered
